name: Friday Backend
description: Friday workspace tools for notes, projects, tasks, reminders, and inbox actions.

baseUrl.description: Friday backend base URL. Defaults to the local backend config or http://127.0.0.1:3010.

sessionPath.description: Absolute path to Friday backend-session.json. Defaults to %APPDATA%\\friday\\state\\backend-session.json.

configPath.description: Absolute path to Friday backend-config.json. Defaults to %APPDATA%\\friday\\state\\backend-config.json.
